description: Source code for a Rose chart visualization component using D3 and NVD3, including data processing, rendering, and interactivity.

classes.name: RoseDataEntry
classes.description: Interface defining a data entry for the Rose chart, including key, name, time, value, and id.

classes.name: RoseData
classes.description: Interface representing the dataset, keyed by timestamp with arrays of RoseDataEntry.

classes.name: ArcDatum
classes.description: Interface for arc segment data used in rendering the chart, including angles, radii, and optional labels.

classes.name: RoseProps
classes.description: Interface for properties accepted by the Rose chart component, including data, dimensions, color scheme, formats, and options.

methods.name: copyArc
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of an ArcDatum object, copying start/end angles and radii.

methods.name: sortValues
methods.description: Comparator function to sort RoseDataEntry objects by value descending, then by name.

methods.name: Rose
methods.description: Main function that initializes and renders the Rose chart visualization within a given HTML element, handling data processing, drawing, and user interactions.
